newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks start at highs, but seen cautious.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks start at highs, but seen cautious.

text.p: MADRID, June 16 (Reuter) 0830 GMT - Madrid stocks opened stronger on Monday, with the general index surpassing its all-time high and the Ibex-35 heading up to next resistance at its all-time of 6,747 on ongoing optimism, dealers said.

Nevertheless, trade was seen curbed by caution until the outcome of the European summit in Amsterdam, although most were optimistic that an agreement on the budget stability pact could be reached, they added.
* General index up 1.34 points, 0.23 percent, to 583.63
* Sol Melia up 90 pesetas to 5,790 after the firm said in an interview it was aiming for a 20 percent earnings increase.
Construction was in the limelight again amid talk of further concentrations in the sector. Dragados was up 1.5 percent to 3,380 pesetas and FCC added two percent to 19,600 pesetas.
Acciona, which rose six percent on Friday, retraced 1.5 percent to 17,700 pesetas.

Volume was lower than in recent sessions, but dealers were still confident of a bullish outlook medium-term on the continued inflow of funds from fixed income markets in search of higher yielding alternatives.
